prov.quant.acc_scale.meaning: Legacy rounded product, informational only; only emitted with float_readout and host_only=true.

prov.quant.accumulator.meaning: i32, the full-width exact integer accumulator. Device readout defaults to full i32, with exact requantization performed separately.

prov.quant.alpha.meaning: Exact binary scalar multiplier of the contraction, included in the rational pair.

prov.quant.arithmetic.meaning: exact means rational/integer math until the required final rounding; eager_float_reassociated makes no exactness claim.

prov.quant.axis.meaning: Q/DQ channel axis (negative axes use tensor rank).

prov.quant.beta.meaning: Exact binary multiplier of the explicit bias operand. The scale pair describes the accumulator coefficient only: an unfused bias operand is additional exact math, not an integer seed.

prov.quant.gradient.meaning: Backward contraction output: input or weight.

prov.quant.granularity.meaning: tensor or channel; a single static scale broadcasts.

prov.quant.host_only.meaning: true forbids accelerator placement: legacy approximate numerics or non-fp32 source scales. Absence/false is not admission or an accumulator-overflow proof.
prov.quant.host_only.required_when: float_readout, or a source scale is not fp32-representable

prov.quant.lhs_scale.meaning: Source lhs scale factor for diagnostics; exact consumers use the rational pair. Accelerator factors must be fp32-representable.

prov.quant.numerics.meaning: integer_readout (exact) or float_readout (legacy approximate and host-only). This is not device-placement permission.

prov.quant.output_scale.meaning: Output Q scale factor, diagnostic; it is already divided into the readout rational pair. Do not divide by it a second time.

prov.quant.quant_max.meaning: Inclusive upper storage-code clamp bound; permits narrow ranges.

prov.quant.quant_min.meaning: Inclusive lower storage-code clamp bound; never an accumulator bound.

prov.quant.relu.meaning: Exact real ReLU before final output quantization.

prov.quant.rhs_scale.meaning: Source rhs scale factor(s), in output-channel order; diagnostic, never a rounded substitute for the rational pair.

prov.quant.rounding.meaning: half_to_even (RNE), before adding zero point and clamping; float results round once to their IEEE result type.

prov.quant.saturate.meaning: Whether final integer codes clamp to quant_min/max; never permits intermediate saturation.

prov.quant.scale.meaning: Informational nearest fp32 representation of the effective scale. Never use for exact computation; optional when rational attributes exist.

prov.quant.scale_denominator.meaning: Positive reduced exact rational denominators; same length and ordering as scale_numerator. Dynamic Q/DQ scales remain SSA operands and cannot be admitted using absent static provenance.

prov.quant.scale_numerator.meaning: Reduced exact rational numerators, paired with scale_denominator. Q/DQ: original scale; contraction: alpha * lhs_scale * rhs_scale; readout: that product / output_scale for integer output, or that product for float output. One entry broadcasts; multiple entries follow the output channel (readout/contraction last axis; Q/DQ axis). Products and ratios are formed exactly from fp32-canonical factors, without rounding the product to fp32.
prov.quant.scale_numerator.required_when: statically known exact scale; both rational arrays must appear together

prov.quant.storage_dtype.meaning: Public quantized storage dtype (int8 or uint8); i8 alone does not express signedness.

prov.quant.zero_point.meaning: Storage zero code, added AFTER round-half-to-even; Q/DQ tensor zero points remain SSA operands when not literal.

prov.quant.zero_point_dtype.meaning: Source zero-point tensor dtype, e.g. int8, uint8, int32, int64; controls extension from signless storage.

op_kinds.contraction: Integer matmul/bmm, including seeded and backward contractions
op_kinds.dequantize: DQ operation, including expanded standard-dialect bodies
op_kinds.integer_readout: Exact accumulator readout, including legacy m2m_q readout operators
op_kinds.quantize: Q operation, including expanded standard-dialect bodies
